While a gate is closed, every row it covers carries 'deferred (gate Gx closed)' as the first flag of its status, its other flags kept

# headline_population (§1.2; frozen-11 rows): 'in' = in the interim population now; 'out (interim): deferred (gate Gx closed; ...); on opening: in|out ...' = listed apart and counted neither way while the gate is closed, with the row's population once it opens; 'out: ...' = excluded by a frozen text (descriptor, published-null, non-ASD, not-ASD, not testable (< 5 columns; prereg §4); an added target is never headline) or deferred without a gate (Vairam / Roy). Not testable as stated, not auditable (incl. S undefined), component-level and 'no calibrated test' claims are in as non-survivals; a family counts once. A full-verdict claim leaves the population if the §1.5 check flags it 'not reproduced'. Composition (v6 R8): one precedence order — deferred > not testable (< 5) > not auditable > not testable as stated > component-level > no calibrated test; a row whose S is conditional on a gated carrier (R2) is counted provisionally ('; provisional: ...')

# sets (register §§1.6, 1.11 items 1-4): the S-build ran before the freeze; every row carries its disposition in set_id (the register_sets id; a family's sets as '<cell index>: <id>' in its defining table's order; 'none (...)' where the row has no set), set_size_in_class_universe (columns of S in the row's analysis-class universe, its HGNC genes beside; the four class universes hold the same 15,633 columns), set_sha256 (of the per-set JSON, as MANIFEST.json records it), set_rule_labels ('S re-derived', 'release substituted', ...) and set_status (the S-build status and the outcome in the row's class, then the set's definition and release). Sets inside a gated carrier read 'built under gate Gx' and are built under that gate by the same rules; an S-undefined set whose source 1 could lie inside a gated carrier reads 'S conditional (source 1 in a gated carrier; else not auditable (S undefined))' (v6 R2)
